mobbin:07782c2f-36d1-44fb-b1a5-d9771b478.summary: The host starts a meeting from the phone, grants mic access, admits a waiting-room participant, then runs the live session with mute and a participant count.
steps: Meetings hub with New Meeting, Join, Schedule
Start a Meeting with Video On and PMI switches
Mic permission dialog; Join Audio; Participants 1
Live toolbar with Mute, Stop Video, Participants 1
Waiting room strip: View or Admit Dexter Lee
Participant tile showing connecting to audio
Video tile with muted mic badge on Dexter Lee
Scrolled toolbar: Participants, Chat, Share, More
steal: A waiting-room message with primary Admit and secondary View (screen 5) lets you admit who enters without opening a full roster.
A Participants count on the toolbar (screens 4, 8 and 9) shows who is in the session at a glance.
Clear Mute versus muted-slash status on the toolbar and on the remote tile (screens 4, 7 and 8) models live versus muted for intercom.
A connecting-to-audio status before they can hear you (screen 6) avoids talking into a dead channel.
avoid: Do not call this recording control. No record start or stop, red REC, or recording lock screen appears in any step.
mobbin:07782c2f-36d1-44fb-b1a5-d9771b478.fit: Mobile and iPad app: the phone wins for in-room admit and mute while walking. It does not show recording control, so it does not replace SRV record. Use it for learner-tagging and intercom cues only.
